value.rationale: The ample dualizing line bundle for every smooth degree-d hypersurface, including non-generic contact schemes, is a structural positivity theorem about a natural lci threefold family. Its exact canonical cubic and Grassmannian Pluecker degree quantify birational positivity and enumerative contact-line geometry; the sextic is the first nontrivial degree. They are not a mere recomputation of the previously tabulated point-locus degree.
